summary: Backend regression is green (7/7). Frontend matrix significantly expanded: secret/file-key/backup/onboarding/admin/account/access flows mostly pass; two real accessibility/focus bugs are confirmed and nav stress shows intermittent external challenge flakiness.

ui_bugs.issue: ArrowLeft does not move focus to previous PIN cell (keyboard navigation broken).
While lock screen is visible, programmatic focus can move to background shell search input.

integration_issues.issue: One stress run was redirected to Cloudflare challenge query URL and login waitForURL timed out; isolated rerun passed.

action_items: Fix onboarding PIN keyboard behavior: add ArrowLeft/ArrowRight handling in MkPinRow so caret/focus moves between digits predictably.
Prevent focus escape behind lock: make app-shell siblings inert/aria-hidden (or equivalent focus guard) while [data-testid='lock-screen'] is mounted.
Stabilize preview auth/navigation under stress against intermittent Cloudflare challenge redirects.
Retest notification exact unlock text after lock setup in a deterministic lock-enabled scenario (current added test blocked by setup precondition, not by wording assertion itself).
critical_code_review_comments: components/mk-fields.tsx: MkPinRow handles Backspace only; no ArrowLeft/ArrowRight handlers, matching reproduced onboarding keyboard defect.
hooks/use-dialog.ts traps Tab/Escape but does not prevent programmatic focus on background app-shell nodes; reproduced with shell-search-input focus while locked.
tests/e2e/23-admin-accounts.spec.ts had stale selector nav-admin; current UI exposes admin entry as topbar-admin-btn. Test was updated and full admin flow now passes.
seed_data_creation: Disposable user created in admin flow e2e and deleted within the same test; temporary licenses exercised via test flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main matrix rerun is largely green (04/09/11/16/23 plus lock/notifs), nav stress has one flaky challenge redirect, and two confirmed product bugs remain: onboarding ArrowLeft PIN navigation and programmatic focus escaping behind lock. New reusable spec added at tests/e2e/44-access-tail-matrix.spec.ts to reproduce both.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: Onboarding PIN cells use MkPinRow where onKeyDown only handles Backspace; arrow navigation is not implemented, so ArrowLeft never shifts focus. RCA-2: Modal trap in useDialog handles Tab/Escape only; background app-shell stays focusable programmatically because non-dialog siblings are not inert, enabling focus to land on shell-search-input while lock screen is active. RCA-3 (flaky): stress run intermittently redirected to Cloudflare challenge login URL, causing waitForURL timeout without app code exception.
